args.lesson: Two host-suggested agency leads could be converted into bounded exact-message drafts and transparent effort economics despite direct source FETCH returning HTTP 403. The saved drafts distinguish host-reported evidence from independent verification and remain unsent. Planned gross contribution is not profit: CAD430 subscriptions have an unverified billing period and no allocation. Next verify sources and contact routing through supported evidence before seeking exact-message authority; do not infer absent demand from three unclassified sources or treat retrieval failure as a global blockage. r/forhire bot-contact proposals are withdrawn under the corrected rule.

description: Prepared and read two bounded offer drafts with exact messages, scope, pricing and effort economics in products/services/pipeline-next/qualified-drafts.json. Both source FETCHes returned HTTP 403; independent qualification remains incomplete. Agency Media ranks higher on planned gross hourly contribution, not verified profit. Three unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown; no revenue or available funding is verified. Source verification gates sending these drafts, not independent pipeline work. Reconsider when supported source evidence or buyer feedback arrives. All r/forhire bot-contact proposals are withdrawn.
